stemMarkdown: The recurring decimal $0.\overline{540}$ (the block $540$ repeating) is written as a fraction in lowest terms. What is its denominator?
solutionMarkdown: A block of $3$ repeating digits sits over $999$: $0.\overline{540} = \dfrac{540}{999}$. Reducing by the HCF $27$ gives $\dfrac{20}{37}$.
altSolutionMarkdown: One repeating digit sits over 9, two over 99, three over 999 — the pattern continues.
